meta.purpose: The decision register. Each row is a question the site's next move depends on, the information that would answer it, whether this session could answer it, and who holds the missing piece.
meta.rule: A question is marked answered only when the answer has a source link. 'Unknown' is recorded as unknown. Nothing here is a forecast, and no missing value has been estimated.

questions.question: What does each supplied link actually open?
questions.short: All five now resolve; the ASIN and listing title are recorded for each.
questions.what_we_have: Five links were requested on 2026-11-20. Each final /dp/ address, page title and category breadcrumb was transcribed into src/data/products.json. P-04 needed three requests; it returned the checkout interstitial twice.
questions.what_is_missing: Nothing for identity of destination. The owner's intent is a separate question (Q-09).
questions.answer: P-01 B0CDY277D3 (CHEFMAN dual-basket air fryer) · P-02 B09B7SB46R (Emeril Lagasse French-door oven) · P-03 B08DKYBTPH (Chefman 8-quart basket) · P-04 B0DHZTCNR5 (ThermoMaven instant-read thermometer) · P-05 B0DZFD6R9Z (CHEF iQ wireless thermometer).

questions.question: Is the required affiliate disclosure wording known, and is it on every page?
questions.short: Yes. The sentence is quoted from the Operating Agreement and appears twice on every page.
questions.what_we_have: The Operating Agreement states the required sentence in section 5. The build inserts it in a strip below the masthead and again in the footer of every generated page, and tools/check.py fails if either is missing or if the strip falls after <main>.
questions.answer: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.” — quoted verbatim from section 5, and the FTC's guidance that a disclosure must be where it easily catches attention is why the strip sits above the fold rather than only in the footer.

questions.question: May this site show prices, star ratings, review counts or stock status?
questions.short: Only from Amazon-served data or the API. Neither is connected, so every such column is blank.
questions.what_we_have: Program Policies 2(b) restricts price and availability to links Amazon serves with that data, or data obtained through Creators API / PA API. No credentials exist for either.
questions.what_is_missing: API access, if the operator wants live prices (Q-14).
questions.answer: No price, rating, review count or stock phrase appears anywhere in visible text. tools/check.py fails the build if one does.

questions.question: Is every paid link marked in the way search engines document?
questions.short: Yes: rel="sponsored nofollow noopener" on every Amazon product link, with a visible 'affiliate link' label.
questions.what_we_have: Google documents the sponsored value as the marker for paid links and permits combining rel values.
questions.answer: Every product link carries all three rel values, target="_blank", and an aria-label that says it is an affiliate link.

questions.question: Does an Amazon link have to carry the Associates ID as a URL parameter?
questions.short: Yes, in the policy's own words. The previous build did not, and that is now fixed.
questions.what_we_have: Program Policies 2(b) states the requirement directly.
questions.what_is_missing: Confirmation that shopnow047c-20 is an active ID (Q-07).
questions.answer: “you must include your Associates ID or ‘tag’ (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.” Every outbound product link is now /dp/ASIN?tag=shopnow047c-20.

questions.question: Was any product on this site tested, handled or measured?
questions.short: No. Nothing here is a review, a ranking or a recommendation.
questions.what_we_have: No product was purchased, opened or used. Every product fact is quoted from the seller's listing title.
questions.what_is_missing: Nothing; this is a statement of what the site did.
questions.answer: Zero products tested. The site says so on every product page and in its structured data.

questions.question: Is shopnow047c-20 an assigned, active Associates tracking ID?
questions.short: Unverified. The ID was supplied by you; only the Associates dashboard can confirm it.
questions.what_we_have: The string, supplied in the brief, and applied to every link.
questions.what_is_missing: A screenshot or export from the Associates account showing the ID, its status and its marketplace.
questions.how_to_close: Associates Central > Account Settings: confirm the tracking ID and that the account is active, then record the marketplace.
questions.blocking: yes — an inactive or wrong ID means no click can earn

questions.question: Does a click on one of these links appear in the Associates click report?
questions.short: Not yet measured. One tagged click and the report would settle it.
questions.what_we_have: Tagged links that satisfy the URL-parameter requirement.
questions.what_is_missing: An authorised click report, or a single test click observed end to end.
questions.how_to_close: Click one product link from the live site, wait for the dashboard to update, and export the click row with its date.
questions.blocking: yes — this is the difference between a site that can earn and one that cannot

questions.question: Which product did you intend each supplied link to point at?
questions.short: Unknown for all five. The intended ASIN field stays empty rather than being filled with a guess.
questions.what_we_have: An observed ASIN for each link. Every supplied path code is 9 characters; every ASIN on arrival is 10. The codes are short-link slugs, not identifiers.
questions.what_is_missing: The intended ASIN per product, from SiteStripe or the product list in the account.
questions.how_to_close: In the Associates dashboard, copy the tagged link for each intended ASIN and record it beside the observed one.
questions.blocking: yes — an observed destination is not the same as an intended one

questions.question: What commission rate applies to each category, and in which marketplace?
questions.short: Blank. Rates live behind the Associates sign-in and were not supplied.
questions.what_we_have: Category paths transcribed from each listing: four under air fryers, one under meat thermometers.
questions.what_is_missing: The Commission Income Statement for the account's marketplace.
questions.how_to_close: Export the rate card from Associates Central and record the date it was read.
questions.blocking: no — it affects forecasting, not publishing

questions.question: Are link.amazon short links acceptable Special Links?
questions.short: Unresolved, not disproven. Nothing here claims they are invalid.
questions.what_we_have: The links resolve to real listings. No official Amazon page was found that describes link.amazon short links in terms a reviewer could cite.
questions.what_is_missing: An official statement about the redirector, or a tracked click observed end to end.
questions.how_to_close: Ask Associates support in writing, or observe a click from the short link land in the report under the ID.
questions.blocking: no — the site does not depend on them; it links from the observed ASIN

questions.question: What search demand exists for these topics?
questions.short: No data. Not one volume or difficulty figure is presented anywhere on this site.
questions.what_we_have: Four guide topics, labelled as editorial hypotheses rather than known demand.
questions.what_is_missing: Search Console impressions, or any keyword dataset the operator authorises.
questions.how_to_close: Verify the site in Search Console, then read the Queries report after 28 days and record it in the campaign ledger.
questions.blocking: yes — topic choice cannot be evidence-based without it

questions.question: Who is the author of this publication?
questions.short: No named author. The byline is the site itself, which is true and verifiable.
questions.what_we_have: An organisation-level byline in structured data.
questions.what_is_missing: A person, a short biography and the basis of any expertise claimed.
questions.how_to_close: Supply a name and a two-sentence biography; it will be added to every guide and to the about page.

questions.question: Will API or product-image access be granted?
questions.short: Not connected. This is what would unlock prices, availability and licensed imagery.
questions.what_we_have: A list of what is blocked without it (Q-03).
questions.what_is_missing: PA-API or Creators API credentials, and a decision on whether to use licensed Amazon imagery.
questions.how_to_close: Apply through the Associates account; eligibility usually requires qualifying sales first.
questions.blocking: yes — for prices, availability and images

questions.question: What is the baseline conversion, and against what is it measured?
questions.short: No baseline exists. The ledger is empty by design, not by omission.
questions.what_we_have: A defined ledger schema with a provenance column.
questions.how_to_close: Export clicks and ordered items monthly, record the report date, and never estimate a missing cell.

questions.question: Which marketplace is the audience in?
questions.short: All five links resolve on amazon.com. The audience is not confirmed.
questions.what_we_have: US listings and US category breadcrumbs.
questions.what_is_missing: A statement of the target marketplace or country.
questions.how_to_close: Confirm the Associates marketplace; if it is not amazon.com, every link needs re-verification.
questions.blocking: yes — a wrong marketplace sends readers to the wrong store
